title: Trapping Rainwater
stepTitle: Stack and Queues [Learning, Pre-In-Post-fix, Monotonic Stack, Implementation]
category: Stack and Queues [Learning, Pre-In-Post-fix, Monotonic Stack, Implementation]
problemStatement: Given heights, how much water can be trapped after raining.
intuition: Water on i = max(0, min(leftMax, rightMax) - height[i]).

approaches.title: Brute per index
Better: prefix/suffix arrays
Optimal: two pointers O(1) space
approaches.idea: Move the side with smaller max.
approaches.whyWorks: The smaller side is bounded by the larger opposite max.

interviewInsight: Climb brute → prefix → two pointers; that ladder is the grade.

related.title: Number of NGEs to the right
